<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0b0d12;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    background: #161a23;
    border: 2px solid #2c3445;
    max-width: 98vw;
    max-height: 98vh;
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="480" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const W = 480, H = 640, HUD_H = 36;
  const BALL_R = 7;
  const BASE_SPEED = 340;          // px/s at level 1, +25 per level
  const MAX_LIVES = 3;
  const LAST_LEVEL = 5;
  const PADDLE = { w: 90, h: 12, y: H - 40, speed: 620 };
  const BRICK = { w: 42, h: 18, gap: 4, top: 70, cols: 10 };
  const HP_COLORS = { 1: '#4fc3f7', 2: '#ffb74d', 3: '#ef5350' };
  const KEY_BEST = 'brickBreaker.best';
  const KEY_PROGRESS = 'brickBreaker.progress';

  // Digits are brick hit points ('0' = empty). Each row has 10 columns.
  const LAYOUTS = [
    // 1: classic wall
    ['1111111111', '1111111111', '1111111111', '1111111111', '1111111111'],
    // 2: checkerboard
    ['2020202020', '0101010101', '2020202020', '0101010101', '2020202020', '0101010101', '2020202020'],
    // 3: pyramid
    ['0000110000', '0001111000', '0011221100', '0112222110', '1122222211'],
    // 4: hardened frame
    ['2222222222', '2000000002', '2011111102', '2010000102', '2010000102', '2011111102', '2000000002', '2222222222'],
    // 5: fortress with a gate and a tough core
    ['3333003333', '3100000013', '3101111013', '3101331013', '3101331013', '3101111013', '3100000013', '3333333333'],
  ];

  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));

  // ---- storage helpers (localStorage can throw, e.g. when blocked) ----
  function safeGet(key) {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function safeSet(key, value) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  function safeRemove(key) {
    try { localStorage.removeItem(key); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  function loadProgress() {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(safeGet(KEY_PROGRESS));
      if (data && Number.isInteger(data.level) && data.level >= 1 && data.level <= LAST_LEVEL
          && Number.isFinite(data.score) && data.score >= 0) {
        return data;
      }
    } catch (e) { /* no or corrupt save */ }
    return null;
  }
  function saveProgress() {
    safeSet(KEY_PROGRESS, JSON.stringify({ level: game.level, score: game.score }));
  }
  function clearProgress() {
    safeRemove(KEY_PROGRESS);
  }

  // ---- game state ----
  // status: 'ready' (ball on paddle) | 'playing' | 'paused' | 'over' | 'won'
  const game = {
    status: 'ready',
    prevStatus: 'ready',
    level: 1,
    score: 0,
    lives: MAX_LIVES,
    best: Number(safeGet(KEY_BEST)) || 0,
  };
  const paddle = { x: (W - PADDLE.w) / 2, y: PADDLE.y, w: PADDLE.w, h: PADDLE.h };
  const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };
  let bricks = [];

  function buildBricks(n) {
    const rows = LAYOUTS[n - 1];
    const originX = (W - (BRICK.cols * (BRICK.w + BRICK.gap) - BRICK.gap)) / 2;
    const list = [];
    rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
        const hp = Number(ch);
        if (!hp) return;
        list.push({
          x: originX + c * (BRICK.w + BRICK.gap),
          y: BRICK.top + r * (BRICK.h + BRICK.gap),
          w: BRICK.w, h: BRICK.h,
          hp, maxHp: hp, alive: true,
        });
      });
    });
    return list;
  }

  function attachBall() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R - 1;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
  }

  function loadLevel(n) {
    game.level = n;
    bricks = buildBricks(n);
    attachBall();
    game.status = 'ready';
    saveProgress();
  }

  function newGame() {
    game.score = 0;
    game.lives = MAX_LIVES;
    loadLevel(1);
  }

  function advanceLevel() {
    if (game.level >= LAST_LEVEL) {
      game.status = 'won';
      clearProgress();
    } else {
      loadLevel(game.level + 1);
    }
  }

  function gameOver() {
    game.lives = 0;
    game.status = 'over';
    clearProgress();
  }

  function addScore(points) {
    game.score += points;
    if (game.score > game.best) {
      game.best = game.score;
      safeSet(KEY_BEST, String(game.best));
    }
  }

  function launch() {
    if (game.status !== 'ready') return;
    const angle = Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3;   // radians off vertical
    const speed = BASE_SPEED + (game.level - 1) * 25;
    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    game.status = 'playing';
  }

  function handleAction() {          // Space or click
    if (game.status === 'ready') launch();
    else if (game.status === 'over' || game.status === 'won') newGame();
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (game.status === 'paused') {
      game.status = game.prevStatus;
    } else if (game.status === 'ready' || game.status === 'playing') {
      game.prevStatus = game.status;
      game.status = 'paused';
    }
  }

  function skipLevel() {            // testing shortcut
    if (game.status === 'ready' || game.status === 'playing') advanceLevel();
  }

  // ---- physics ----
  function moveBall(h) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * h;
    ball.y += ball.vy * h;

    // side and top walls
    if (ball.x - BALL_R < 0) { ball.x = BALL_R; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    else if (ball.x + BALL_R > W) { ball.x = W - BALL_R; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.y - BALL_R < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + BALL_R; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // paddle: the hit position decides the outgoing angle (up to 60 degrees)
    if (ball.vy > 0
        && ball.y + BALL_R >= paddle.y
        && ball.y - BALL_R < paddle.y + paddle.h
        && ball.x >= paddle.x - BALL_R
        && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + BALL_R) {
      const t = clamp((ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2), -1, 1);
      const angle = t * (Math.PI / 3);
      const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
      ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - BALL_R;
    }

    // bricks: one collision per step, bounce off the side that was hit
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const nx = clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
      const ny = clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
      const dx = ball.x - nx, dy = ball.y - ny;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy > BALL_R * BALL_R) continue;

      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
        ball.vx = (dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1) * Math.abs(ball.vx);
        ball.x = dx >= 0 ? b.x + b.w + BALL_R : b.x - BALL_R;
      } else {
        ball.vy = (dy >= 0 ? 1 : -1) * Math.abs(ball.vy);
        ball.y = dy >= 0 ? b.y + b.h + BALL_R : b.y - BALL_R;
      }

      b.hp--;
      if (b.hp <= 0) {
        b.alive = false;
        addScore(10 * b.maxHp);
      }
      break;
    }

    // ball fell past the paddle
    if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) {
      game.lives--;
      if (game.lives <= 0) {
        gameOver();
      } else {
        attachBall();
        game.status = 'ready';
      }
    }
  }

  function update(dt) {
    if (game.status !== 'ready' && game.status !== 'playing') return;

    const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
    paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x + dir * PADDLE.speed * dt, 0, W - paddle.w);

    if (game.status === 'ready') {
      attachBall();
      return;
    }

    // sub-step so a fast ball cannot tunnel through a brick
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt / 3));
    for (let i = 0; i < steps && game.status === 'playing'; i++) {
      moveBall(dt / steps);
    }

    if (game.status === 'playing' && bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) {
      advanceLevel();
    }
  }

  // ---- rendering ----
  function drawHud() {
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = 'bold 15px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8ecf4';
    const y = HUD_H / 2;
    ctx.fillText(`Score: ${game.score}`, 12, y);
    ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${game.lives}`, 150, y);
    ctx.fillText(`Level: ${game.level}`, 265, y);
    ctx.fillText(`Best: ${game.best}`, 370, y);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2c3445';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 1, W, 1);
  }

  function drawCenteredMessage(title, hint) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8ceda';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(hint, W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    switch (game.status) {
      case 'ready':
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c8ceda';
        ctx.fillText('Press Space or click to launch', W / 2, H * 0.6);
        break;
      case 'paused':
        drawCenteredMessage('Paused', 'Press P to resume');
        break;
      case 'over':
        drawCenteredMessage('Game over', 'Press Space or click to play again');
        break;
      case 'won':
        drawCenteredMessage('You win', 'Press Space or click to play again');
        break;
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#161a23';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawHud();

    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = HP_COLORS[b.hp];
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8ecf4';
    ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fill();

    drawOverlay();
  }

  // ---- input ----
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft':
        keys.left = true;
        e.preventDefault();
        break;
      case 'ArrowRight':
        keys.right = true;
        e.preventDefault();
        break;
      case ' ':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!e.repeat) handleAction();
        break;
      default:
        if (e.repeat) return;
        if (e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P') togglePause();
        else if (e.key === 'n' || e.key === 'N') skipLevel();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
  });

  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    keys.left = false;
    keys.right = false;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (game.status !== 'ready' && game.status !== 'playing') return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    paddle.x = clamp(x - paddle.w / 2, 0, W - paddle.w);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('click', handleAction);

  // ---- start ----
  const saved = loadProgress();
  if (saved) {
    game.score = saved.score;
    game.best = Math.max(game.best, game.score);
    game.lives = MAX_LIVES;
    loadLevel(saved.level);
  } else {
    newGame();
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 44px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8ceda';
    ctx.font = '16px Arial';
    ctx.fillText(hint, W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
  }

  function drawOverlay() {
    switch (game.status) {
      case 'ready':
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.font = '16px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c8ceda';
        ctx.fillText('Press Space or click to launch', W / 2, H * 0.6);
        break;
      case 'paused':
        drawCenteredMessage('Paused', 'Press P to resume');
        break;
      case 'over':
        drawCenteredMessage('Game over', 'Press Space or click to play again');
        break;
      case 'won':
        drawCenteredMessage('You win', 'Press Space or click to play again');
        break;
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#161a23';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawHud();

    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = HP_COLORS[b.hp];
      ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#e8ecf4';
    ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fill();

    drawOverlay();
  }

  // ---- input ----
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft':
        keys.left = true;
        e.preventDefault();
        break;
      case 'ArrowRight':
        keys.right = true;
        e.preventDefault();
        break;
      case ' ':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!e.repeat) handleAction();
        break;
      default:
        if (e.repeat) return;
        if (e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P') togglePause();
        else if (e.key === 'n' || e.key === 'N') skipLevel();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
  });

  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    keys.left = false;
    keys.right = false;
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (game.status !== 'ready' && game.status !== 'playing') return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    paddle.x = clamp(x - paddle.w / 2, 0, W - paddle.w);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('click', handleAction);

  // ---- start ----
  const saved = loadProgress();
  if (saved) {
    game.score = saved.score;
    game.best = Math.max(game.best, game.score);
    game.lives = MAX_LIVES;
    loadLevel(saved.level);
  } else {
    newGame();
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
